messages:
Eden: Dropping a fresh one-pager draft called 'Orbit'  field brief for enterprise buyers focused on secure inference, SLA plumbing, and deploy-mode decisioning. Need quick eyes on hero stat, webinar hook, and inbound routing tags. Draft: https://redwood.internal/briefs/orbit (internal).

Priya: Nice name. Quick ask  whos the primary buyer? CISO, platform, or solutions engineers? We should call out two lines: security + measurable ops win.

Marco: Benchnotes: Dedicated + caching + 4-bit quantization runs. Conservative stat: "~37% lower inference unit cost, ~28% improved 95th-pct latency". I'll attach PNGs in the brief.

Samir: For SLAs: propose copy: "Dedicated: 99.9% uptime SLA; Private (VPC/on-prem): contractual SLA options; Hosted: regional redundancy + automated fallback." Short and clear.

Eden: Routing snippet for ops intake (please format into their YAML):
```yaml
inbound:
  tags: ["enterprise","Orbit","secure-inference","vpc","onprem","dedicated","SLA","eval-kit"]
  assign: sales-eng
  priority: high
  funnel_label: evaluation-request
  intake_note: "attach workload sample, desired latency, and compliance/regulatory notes"
```

Priya: Add quick-filter tags: 'nda-needed' and 'bring-your-workload'. Field asked for a separate tag if they want an InfoSec call: 'infosec-review'.

Marco: Webinar headline (short): "Orbit: secure, predictable inference for regulated apps". Blurb: "Join our 40-minute deep dive: secure serving patterns, benchmark stories, and how to run a free evaluation with your workload. Live Q&A with product + field." Agenda: 1) architecture & SLAs 2) benchmark deep-dive 3) evaluation kit walkthrough + next steps.

Samir: Social post (short): "New brief: Orbit  how teams cut inference cost and meet SLAs for regulated apps. Register for the webinar and request an evaluation kit." Add UTM in the final link.

Eden: Sales play appendix (short): discovery checklist (workload profile, throughput & latency targets, compliance needs), suggested pricing appendix, demo next steps. Field wants a one-line play to copy into AE notes.

ops-bot: Webinar slot request submitted: 2026-07-08 09:00 PT  request 7102.

Priya: I'll tighten the security TL;DR and add the SLA callout by EOD. Marco  upload the PNGs and the tiny table for the one-pager. Eden  can you add the routing YAML to the ops handoff doc?

Eden: Yes. If no objections I'll publish the internal brief tomorrow AM and hand routing to ops. Final owners: copy (Priya), benchmarks (Marco), routing handoff (Eden), webinar comms (Samir). :white_check_mark:
